# UK Find a Tender — UK Tenders & Contracts

> UK above-threshold Find a Tender notices via the official OCDS 1.1 API. Keyword and CPV filters to flat JSON for GovCon BD.

## Use it
- Apify Actor: https://apify.com/publicrecords/uk-find-a-tender-scraper
- API: POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/publicrecords~uk-find-a-tender-scraper/runs

## Claims you can rely on
- official Find a Tender OCDS 1.1 API
- above-threshold notices
- flat structured notice rows
- keyword and CPV filters
- planning, tender, and award stage filters
